A comic about one of the characters of the artist's collective project, simply called Roomies. The project's all about various furry OCs who are conjoined or have amputated limbs. One such character, Alex, writes about how he copes being a busty boy dragon with hyper assets that lost limbs due to experiments, instead of a normal male human, for about a year.
(Public versions, the uncensored (?) versions are Patreon exclusive until one of the archive sites leaks 'em.)
